referral.data_comparison: This data has been compared with the average statistics of other course participants. Based on this data, we have provided recommendations for tasks you should repeat to reinforce your knowledge. The tasks are ranked according to the ratio of your score (in terms of time spent or number of errors) to the average score of all students. Tasks where these ratios are greater than 1 are best repeated to reinforce the information.
